newsitem.title: USA: Innovir majority stake taken by group.
newsitem.headline: Innovir majority stake taken by group.

text.p: A group including Paramount Capital Asset Management Inc said Monday it bought the equivalent of a 62.07 percent stake in Innovir Laboratories Inc, or 12.0 million common shares

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said that under an August 30 purchase agreement, it bought 4.0 million common shares, 4.0 million class C warrants and 2.0 million unit purchase options.
In addition, options to buy 1.0 million class C warrants and 1.0 million common shares were issued to the group.
The group said it paid $2.0 million for the initial purchases of Innovir securities.

The group said it named two representatives to the Innovir board and held talks with the company's management and certain board members about several proposals concerning overall corporate strategy and focus of the company.
The group and the company had not determined whether those proposals were feasible and whether the company would pursue them, the group said.
